comparison.objective: Order, orient, and insert four tape cartridges, versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Barcode reading, regrasp/handover for orientation, slot alignment, insertion, and release versus hex-tool engagement, collar tuning, relocking, and repeated cycle assessment.
comparison.success_condition: Cartridges 1–4 correctly ordered, label-out, upright, flush, and untouched for one second versus two safe damped stops and retained collar position.
comparison.reason: This tests semantic sequencing and repeated keyed insertion, not dynamic calibration. No spec versions are present; 'flush' and orientation tolerances are not quantified in the body.
